highlights.reason_zh: 65B Apache 2.0 权重降低本地 coding model 试验门槛，但 benchmark 仍需同 harness 复现。
highlights.reason_en: Apache-2.0 65B weights lower the barrier for local coding-model trials, while benchmarks need same-harness reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开代码和 Lean proof 让模型身份可验证，但 proving 开销仍限制生产使用。
highlights.reason_en: Public code and Lean proofs make model identity verifiable, while proving overhead still limits production use.

highlights.reason_zh: GA、15 秒视频与降价直接改变视频生成 API 的生产可行性。
highlights.reason_en: GA, 15-second clips and lower pricing directly change the production case for video-generation APIs.

highlights.reason_zh: 受限开放的 cyber 模型已进入真实漏洞研究，但厂商证据与高风险控制必须一起看。
highlights.reason_en: A restricted cyber model has entered real vulnerability research, but first-party evidence and high-risk controls must be read together.

highlights.reason_zh: 同内容任务只因安全表述就出现完成率差距，会直接影响 red-team 与安全评测可信度。
highlights.reason_en: A framing-dependent completion gap directly affects trust in red-team and safety evaluations.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部读取；另补查开放权重、形式化验证、agent 隐私、并购和中英文材料。ToyBlocks 与 PJIT-21K 页面不可读；多项厂商结果仍待独立复现。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were read, with added checks across open weights, formal verification, agent privacy, acquisitions, and Chinese- and English-language sources. ToyBlocks and PJIT-21K were inaccessible; several vendor results await independent reproduction.
